entries.description: Point lookup: true wind speed @max at a single 10s bucket
entries.ti_sql:
SELECT vessel, ts, "environment.wind.speedTrue@max" AS wind_max
FROM telemetry
WHERE vessel = 'vessels.urn:mrn:imo:mmsi:367000000' AND ts = TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01 12:00:00'
ORDER BY ts
entries.oracle_sql:
SELECT context AS vessel,
       time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS ts,
       round(round(max(value), 3), 3) AS wind_max
FROM raw
WHERE path = 'environment.wind.speedTrue' AND context = 'vessels.urn:mrn:imo:mmsi:367000000'
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING ts = TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01 12:00:00'
ORDER BY ts

entries.description: Motivating query (spec 01): wind>4m/s, bilge>=3, port started, match notes, 90d
entries.ti_sql:
SELECT vessel, date_bin(INTERVAL '10 minutes', ts) AS win,
       max("environment.wind.speedTrue@max") AS wind_max
FROM telemetry
WHERE "propulsion.port.state" = 'started'
  AND "electrical.bilge.pumpCycles" >= 3
  AND "environment.wind.speedTrue@max" > 4.0
   AND match(notes, 'leak OR water')
   AND ts > TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY vessel, win
entries.oracle_sql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel,
         time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt,
         round(max(value), 3) AS wmax
  FROM raw WHERE path = 'environment.wind.speedTrue'
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
b AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel,
         time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt,
         count(*) AS cyc
  FROM raw WHERE path = 'electrical.bilge.pumpCycles'
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
s AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel,
         time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt
  FROM raw WHERE path = 'propulsion.port.state'
  GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING arg_max(value_str, ts) = 'started'),
n AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT context AS vessel,
         unnest(generate_series(time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts_start, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01'), COALESCE(ts_end - INTERVAL '1 second', ts_start), INTERVAL '10 seconds')) AS bkt
  FROM docs
  WHERE kind = 'notes' AND (lower(body) LIKE '%leak%' OR lower(body) LIKE '%water%')
    AND context = 'vessels.urn:mrn:imo:mmsi:367000000')
SELECT w.vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', w.bkt, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS win,
       round(max(w.wmax), 3) AS wind_max
FROM w JOIN b ON w.vessel=b.vessel AND w.bkt=b.bkt
       JOIN s ON w.vessel=s.vessel AND w.bkt=s.bkt
       JOIN n ON w.vessel=n.vessel AND w.bkt=n.bkt
WHERE w.wmax > 4.0 AND b.cyc >= 3 AND w.bkt > TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY w.vessel, win

entries.description: 4 conjuncts: port started, SOG in range, wind speed >, depth < (set=, bsi BETWEEN, bsi >, bsi <)
entries.ti_sql:
SELECT vessel, ts, "navigation.speedOverGround@max" AS sog
FROM telemetry
WHERE vessel = 'vessels.urn:mrn:imo:mmsi:367000000'
  AND "propulsion.port.state" = 'started'
  AND "navigation.speedOverGround@max" BETWEEN 2.5 AND 5.0
  AND "environment.wind.speedTrue@max" > 8.0
  AND "environment.depth.belowTransducer@min" < 10.0
  AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-07' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-08'
ORDER BY ts
entries.oracle_sql:
WITH sog AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt, round(max(value), 3) AS v
  FROM raw WHERE path='navigation.speedOverGround' GROUP BY 1,2),
w AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt, round(max(value), 3) AS v
  FROM raw WHERE path='environment.wind.speedTrue' GROUP BY 1,2),
d AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt, round(min(value), 2) AS v
  FROM raw WHERE path='environment.depth.belowTransducer' GROUP BY 1,2),
s AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt
  FROM raw WHERE path='propulsion.port.state' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING arg_max(value_str, ts) = 'started')
SELECT sog.vessel, sog.bkt AS ts, round(sog.v, 3) AS sog
FROM sog JOIN w ON sog.vessel=w.vessel AND sog.bkt=w.bkt
         JOIN d ON sog.vessel=d.vessel AND sog.bkt=d.bkt
         JOIN s ON sog.vessel=s.vessel AND sog.bkt=s.bkt
WHERE sog.vessel='vessels.urn:mrn:imo:mmsi:367000000' AND sog.v BETWEEN 2.5 AND 5.0 AND w.v > 8.0 AND d.v < 10.0
  AND sog.bkt >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-07' AND sog.bkt < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-08'
ORDER BY ts

entries.description: set IN + bsi > + bsi < + IS NOT NULL (presence) + NOT
entries.ti_sql:
SELECT vessel, ts
FROM telemetry
WHERE vessel = 'vessels.urn:mrn:imo:mmsi:367000000'
  AND "propulsion.main.state" IN ('started','idle')
  AND "electrical.batteries.house.stateOfCharge@min" < 0.40
  AND "electrical.solar.house.panelPower@max" > 100.0
  AND "environment.outside.temperature@mean" IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT ("propulsion.port.state" = 'reverse')
  AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01'
ORDER BY ts
entries.oracle_sql:
WITH soc AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt, round(min(value), 4) AS v
  FROM raw WHERE path='electrical.batteries.house.stateOfCharge' GROUP BY 1,2),
sol AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt, round(max(value), 1) AS v
  FROM raw WHERE path='electrical.solar.house.panelPower' GROUP BY 1,2),
tmp AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt, round(avg(value), 2) AS v
  FROM raw WHERE path='environment.outside.temperature' GROUP BY 1,2),
main AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt
  FROM raw WHERE path='propulsion.main.state' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING arg_max(value_str, ts) IN ('started','idle')),
rev AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt, arg_max(value_str, ts) AS st
  FROM raw WHERE path='propulsion.port.state' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT soc.vessel, soc.bkt AS ts
FROM soc JOIN sol ON soc.vessel=sol.vessel AND soc.bkt=sol.bkt
         JOIN tmp ON soc.vessel=tmp.vessel AND soc.bkt=tmp.bkt
         JOIN main ON soc.vessel=main.vessel AND soc.bkt=main.bkt
         JOIN rev ON soc.vessel=rev.vessel AND soc.bkt=rev.bkt
WHERE soc.vessel='vessels.urn:mrn:imo:mmsi:367000000' AND soc.v < 0.40 AND sol.v > 100.0 AND tmp.v IS NOT NULL
  AND rev.st IS DISTINCT FROM 'reverse' AND soc.bkt >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01'
ORDER BY ts

entries.description: col-vs-col comparison (unsupported pushdown): apparent vs true wind ratio [narrowed to 05-07 00:00–06:00 UTC to keep the golden output small]
entries.ti_sql:
SELECT vessel, ts,
       "environment.wind.speedApparent@max" AS app,
       "environment.wind.speedTrue@max" AS true_w
FROM telemetry
WHERE vessel = 'vessels.urn:mrn:imo:mmsi:367000000'
  AND "environment.wind.speedApparent@max" > "environment.wind.speedTrue@max"
  AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-07 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-07 06:00:00'
ORDER BY ts
entries.oracle_sql:
WITH app AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt, round(max(value), 3) AS v
  FROM raw WHERE path='environment.wind.speedApparent' GROUP BY 1,2),
tw AS (
  SELECT context AS vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 seconds', ts, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') AS bkt, round(max(value), 3) AS v

SELECT app.vessel, app.bkt AS ts,

       round(tw.v, 3) AS true_w

WHERE app.vessel='vessels.urn:mrn:imo:mmsi:367000000' AND app.v > tw.v AND app.bkt >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-07 00:00:00' AND app.bkt < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-07 06:00:00'

  FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01' GROUP BY hr),

entries.description: Per-day mean as a join (the decorrelated form of qx-003): buckets where wind exceeds the day's mean wind [narrowed to 05-07 00:00–06:00 UTC]
entries.ti_sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT vessel, date_bin(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, avg("environment.wind.speedTrue") AS a
  FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT t.ts, t."environment.wind.speedTrue@max" AS wmax
FROM telemetry t JOIN d ON d.vessel = t.vessel AND d.day = date_bin(INTERVAL '1 day', t.ts)
WHERE t.vessel = 'vessels.urn:mrn:imo:mmsi:367000000' AND t.ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-07 00:00:00' AND t.ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-07 06:00:00'
  AND t."environment.wind.speedTrue@max" > d.a
ORDER BY t.ts

WITH w AS (

  FROM raw WHERE path='environment.wind.speedTrue' GROUP BY 1,2)

FROM w
WHERE w.vessel='vessels.urn:mrn:imo:mmsi:367000000' AND w.bkt >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-07 00:00:00' AND w.bkt < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-07 06:00:00'
  AND w.v > (SELECT avg(w2.a) FROM w w2
             WHERE w2.vessel = w.vessel
               AND time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', w2.bkt, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01') = time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', w.bkt, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01'))
ORDER BY ts
